book.name: 1 Corintios
book.title: Pablo Kepegin Jesúsgin-kwenamalad-Corintogin-pukmaladga Karta Palmijad 1 Corintios

content: Pe pirkin Pab-igal-wijiidbal pe melle iskuedgin kwenad-aku-Pab-wijiid-egwano

Imisgin an pemalga chunmabijundo, tule Pab-Tummadyob-chowal-mimmiganga moli-chan ukchamaladgin. Tenal anmal wismaldo, anmal-pel-kwapa Pab-Jesús-igal wismal. Tenal tule pirkin-igal-wijiil, tummarba tule-ima. Tenal tule pilaledgin naneel, tule-penta Pab-Jesúsgin tunkugal.
Tenal tule-walgwen chogel ede pél immal wiis, we tule ampa immal kwen wichul, ampa peyedzhe napi.
Tenal tule Pab-nued-pilalel, Pabdin mag we tule-takmogo.

Tenal tule-chowal-mimmiganga-immal-chan-ukchadbal an immal-chan-kunmalad-igalgin, an chunmanejun. Imi anmal nued wismaldo, chowal-mimmigan iti-napkin ibga keg pel ku, tenal Pab Tummadbi, Pab Tummadga walkwénna mai.
Tenal tulemal chogmal, pab-tummagan ichejul nika-ne, tegin tule-tummagan-purpalmalad ichejul nika-nemalbal. Tenal tule weob chogzhad ib-chunchunnadzhul.

Tenal chowal-mimmigan nikpa-neggin o iti-napkin pab-tummaganga mamimalalen, tenal anmalgadin ampa Pab-Tummad-Tuladbi walkwénna maido. Tegin Jesucristobi walkwénna tule-tummadga maibaldo. Tenal immalmal-pel-kwapa Jesucristobal Pab-Tummad-akar tani. Tegin anmal Jesucristobal tula-kudimalbal Pab Tummadga pél immal imagal.

Tenal tulemal ampa kwénna-kwénna we igal kwen wichulmal-choggu, al kusgu chowal-mimmiganga chan-uked-igalgin ampa pinzhealdamal. Al tulemal chowal-mimmiganga-chan-ukchad kunnalil, ampa chowal-mimmigangin pinzhealdamalbal. Tenal tulemal pab-tummad-pidyob ampa chowal-mimmigan-tak-choggu, al tulemal ampa tobe-tobe we chan kunmal. Al we tulemal Pab Tummadbak iskusmalzhun.

Tenal mas-kunned tule-kwen-pentajul, Pab Tummadbak ai-nuedga kugal. Tenal anmal mas kuchal, Pab-wagin anmal-kwen-nudajul. Tenal anmal mas kunchulbalil, Pab-wagin ampa anmal-kwen-izhojulbal. Al we igal ampa pog-pel yopígwadbi.
Imi pemal-Pab-nued-wismalad, pe nuekwa pinzhemalo, akpenegwad-igalgin-kalesgudiid-akar pe nojadbal, pe melle iskuedgin kwenad-nue-Pab-Jesús-wichulmalad-egwano.

¿Ibiga an pemalga weob chog? Imi pe pirkin Pab-igal wiis-choggu, al tule-nue-Pab-Jesús-wichulid chowal-mimmiganzhe-koled-neggin mas-kunchii pe takalil, ¿ampa penedgin chowal-mimmiganga-chan-ukchad kunmogojulzhí? Teobdo.
Tenal Cristo nakrusgin ampa we kwenadga purkwismo-choggu, ¿tede, pe ibiga Pab-Jesús-igal-wijiidbal we kwenad-nue-Pab-Jesús-wichulid-izhomal? Pemal weob kwenad-imaked-wilub-chul.
Tenal pe Cristogin-kwenad izhononikil, pe pukib kwenad-opinzhenaidbal, pe Cristogin walmanaimo.
Al an chogzhundo, an takel, an chan-kunnoedbal iskuedgin Jesúsgin-kwenad-egwano, antin chan pal kwen kunnojul, melle iskuedgin Jesúsgin-kwenad-egwangal.
